question: What claim about agency requires the yoginī named by wish to extend up to Māyā by the supreme wish of the siddhas?
premises: There is a yoginī named Icchā.
She is related to the siddhas.
By supreme wish she extends up to the end of Māyā.
inference: The yoginī named Icchā, by the supreme wish of the siddhas, extends up to Māyā.
plain_english: The yoginī named Icchā, by the supreme wish of the siddhas, extends up to Māyā.
